shortDescription: 3M Gulf serves as the regional headquarters for 3M in the Middle East, supplying science-based industrial, safety, healthcare, and consumer products.
whatTheyDo: 3M Gulf distributes personal protective equipment, industrial adhesives, abrasives, medical and dental supplies, and automotive aftermarket solutions. In Dubai, it operates regional executive leadership, customer technical support, and the 3M Innovation Centre for product application engineering. It serves key sectors including healthcare providers, telecommunications networks, construction firms, and general manufacturing industries across the UAE.
address: Building 11, Dubai Internet City, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

shortDescription: 7X is the UAE's state-owned holding group managing postal, express logistics, digital parcel infrastructure, and financial service entities.
whatTheyDo: 7X oversees operating subsidiaries including Emirates Post, EMX courier and parcel delivery, FINTX financial solutions, and Electronic Documents Centre (EDC). In the UAE, it manages nationwide mail delivery, last-mile e-commerce logistics, smart locker networks through NXN, digital address platforms like Wayn, and international freight forwarding. Its technical and operational units serve individual residents, corporate enterprises, and government authorities across all seven emirates.
address: Street 54 (near Al Mawakeb School), Al Garhoud, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

sources.title: Logistics firm 7X, University of Dubai join hands to empower young talent - People Matters

notes: Input area listed as Business Bay, but corporate headquarters is located on Street 54, Al Garhoud. Emirates Post Group officially rebranded as 7X in 2024.

shortDescription: Aal Mir Trading Co. L.L.C is a premier FMCG distributor and trading company in the UAE specialising in confectionery, beverages, and packaged foodstuffs.
whatTheyDo: Aal Mir Trading Co. L.L.C imports, markets, and distributes international confectionery, biscuits, snacks, canned goods, and grocery products across the UAE and GCC. It operates extensive temperature-controlled warehousing, logistics hubs, and fleet distribution based in Dubai Investments Park. The company supplies modern trade hypermarkets, supermarkets, convenience stores, and wholesale distribution networks throughout the country.
address: Building 598-932, 78 Street, Dubai Investments Park 1, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

sources.title: Aal Mir Group Profile - Kompass UAE

notes: Input listed area as JLT, but verified corporate headquarters and main distribution centre are located in Dubai Investments Park 1 (DIP 1).

shortDescription: ABB Industries LLC is the UAE operating subsidiary of global technology company ABB, specializing in electrification and industrial automation.
whatTheyDo: ABB Industries LLC engineers, supplies, and services power distribution equipment, medium- and low-voltage switchgear, variable frequency drives, industrial electric motors, and robotic automation systems. In the UAE, it maintains technical engineering, assembly, repair, and field service facilities in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. It serves regional utility providers (DEWA, ADDC), oil and gas producers, infrastructure developers, and industrial manufacturing plants.
address: Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, 4th Interchange, Street No. 4, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

shortDescription: Abu Dhabi Aviation is the largest commercial helicopter and fixed-wing aircraft operator in the Middle East and North Africa.
whatTheyDo: Abu Dhabi Aviation provides offshore aviation transport support for oil and gas production, medical evacuation, search and rescue missions, VIP executive passenger charters, and aerial photography. It operates aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) hangars and flight training simulator centres at its dedicated terminal at Zayed International Airport. It primarily serves state oil companies, government departments, and international aviation operators.

shortDescription: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank (ADCB) is a major UAE banking institution offering consumer, commercial, Islamic, and investment banking services.
whatTheyDo: ADCB delivers retail banking, corporate and commercial lending, Islamic banking products, treasury services, trade finance, and private wealth management. Across the UAE, it manages an extensive branch network and digital platforms supported by information technology, cyber defence, risk modelling, and corporate finance units in Abu Dhabi. It serves retail depositors, growing small and medium businesses, large corporations, and public sector organizations.

shortDescription: Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB) is a leading Islamic financial institution headquartered in Abu Dhabi providing comprehensive Sharia-compliant banking services.
whatTheyDo: ADIB provides retail, business, corporate, and private Islamic banking products alongside Islamic treasury, capital markets, and trade finance solutions. In the UAE, it maintains a nationwide branch network, digital mobile platforms, and central operational, risk management, and fintech units based in Abu Dhabi. It caters to individual retail consumers, small and medium enterprises, multinational corporations, and government institutions.

shortDescription: Accenture is a global professional services firm delivering strategy, digital transformation, cloud engineering, and technology consulting across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Accenture provides corporate strategy consulting, enterprise cloud implementation, systems integration, digital experience design (Accenture Song), cybersecurity, and operations management. In the UAE, its consultants and engineers drive large-scale digital initiatives, national technology agendas, and business modernizations for public sector entities, financial institutions, telecom operators, and energy companies. shortDescription: Accor operates its regional corporate headquarters for the Middle East, Africa, and Turkey in Dubai, managing a large portfolio of international hotel brands.
whatTheyDo: Accor manages luxury, premium, midscale, and economy hospitality properties throughout the UAE, including Raffles, Fairmont, Sofitel, Pullman, Novotel, and Ibis. It serves hospitality investors, business and leisure hotel guests, corporate travel managers, and food and beverage patrons.

shortDescription: Adecco Middle East is a prominent human resources, staffing, and workforce solutions consultancy operating across the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Adecco Middle East provides permanent professional recruitment, contingent and temporary staffing, executive search, outsourced HR administration, and payroll management services across the UAE. From its offices in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, its specialized recruitment consultants place talent in sectors including banking, technology, engineering, retail, and corporate functions. It also runs dedicated workforce nationalisation programs supporting UAE Emiratisation targets.
